description: Test per-cell ROC-AUC on the precious-metal (Ru, Ir, Rh, Os, Re) 9-cell-line subset of MetalCytoToxDB overlapping with the NCI-60 panel (k=9 cell-line panel; 9 with MEASURED AUC) with D-MPNN k-cell-line multi-task (9 cls + 9 reg heads).  UPDATED 2026-10-12: the fixed-splitter rerun gave DU145 a measured AUC (1.0 on n_test=7), so the panel mean is now over 9 cells.  DU145 (n_test=7) and SKOV3 (n_test=3) have single-digit test sets where an AUC of 1.0 is not informative; they inflate the mean and dominate the spread.
unit: ROC-AUC (0-1, higher better) per cell line
honest_framing: Data source: MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal (Ru, Ir, Rh, Os, Re) x NCI-60 9-cell-line subset (5,207 rows); NCI-60 raw release has no SMILES so we use MetalCytoToxDB precious subset restricted to NCI-60-overlapping cell lines. Model: D-MPNN k-cell-line multi-task (dmpnn_kcell_multitask) with 9 cls + 9 reg heads. Protocol: scaffold split, 3 seeds [0,1,2], 50 epochs. Krasnov 2026 baseline = 0.81 cite-only; iMoLD cite-only. NOT a head-to-head against Krasnov chemprop v2 reference — same-protocol comparison requires chemprop v2 backbone + full training. Cites TODO-140/141/142/143/144. [Aggregate correction 2026-10-03: the 0.8007 headline is the mean over the 8 cell lines with MEASURED AUC; DU145 is null across all 3 seeds and excluded. The earlier '9-cell-line' summary and n_cells=9 overstated the measured panel; see corrections[]. Headline value + value_overall_mean_std unchanged — both recompute exactly from the 8 measured cells (std = pop-std of the 3 per-seed overall means = 0.015980).]
framing: NCI-60 raw release has no SMILES; we use the MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal subset restricted to 9 NCI-60-overlapping cell lines.

resolvable_subset.why: A per-cell AUC on a test set smaller than 20 is not evidence.  Excluded here: DU145 (n_test=7, AUC=1.0000), HL60 (n_test=11, AUC=0.8000), PC3 (n_test=18, AUC=0.8028), SKOV3 (n_test=3, AUC=1.0000).  The unweighted 9-cell mean gives each of those the same weight as A549 (n_test=107), which is why it is the larger number.

fixed_split_rerun_2026_10_12.why: the prior per_cell_line values were measured on the degenerate scaffold splitter (BLK-PA12: ScaffoldSplitter._scaffold_for returned '' for every molecule, so the 'scaffold' split was molecule-level). Re-measured on the fixed splitter.

tiny_test_set_warning.why_it_matters: the fixed scaffold split holds out whole scaffolds, so the total test pool shrinks dramatically (m21 split 3645/521/1041 -> 4860/115/232). Some per-cell-line test sets collapse to single digits (SKOV3 n_test=3, DU145 n_test=7), where an AUC of 1.0 is not informative. The overall mean is therefore dominated by a handful of large lines and carries a much larger spread (std 0.214 vs 0.016).

honest_negative.statement: On the fixed Bemis-Murcko scaffold split the 9-cell NCI-60 headline drops from 0.8007 to 0.7294, and several cell lines sit at or below chance (A2780cis 0.3356, A2780 0.5104) on very small test sets. The old 0.8007 was measured on a molecule-level split labelled 'scaffold'.

test_set_size_funnel.why: BLK-PA16: the 9-cell mean mixes single-digit test sets (SKOV3 n=3, DU145 n=7) where AUC=1.0 is uninformative with large near-chance lines.  Recompute under explicit minimum-test-set-size filters.
test_set_size_funnel.protocol_mismatch_note: Krasnov 2026's 0.81 is a within-metal stratified 5-fold CV (random split).  This panel is measured on a Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (whole scaffolds held out), which is strictly harder.  The two numbers are not like-for-like; the scaffold-split panel should be compared to a random-split re-measurement of the same panel.
test_set_size_funnel.verdict: Under the BLK-PA16 n_test>=20 filter the panel mean is 0.5923 over 5 cell lines, versus 0.7294 over all 9.  The n_test>=10 sensitivity gives 0.6521 over 7.  Both are BELOW the 0.81 comparator, so on this panel the honest reading is an explicit miss — not a tie, and not a win.  The comparison is also protocol-mismatched (scaffold split here vs Krasnov's random within-metal CV).
test_set_size_funnel.honest_framing: MEASURED, recomputed from on-disk values.  No cell line is dropped from the record: the unfiltered mean and every per_cell_line entry are preserved above.
